description: This file defines the PayGradeDao class, which is a Data Access Object responsible for managing and retrieving pay grade and currency data from the database within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for fetching, saving, deleting, and filtering pay grade entities and associated currencies.

classes.name: PayGradeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling operations related to PayGrade entities and related currencies in the database.

methods.name: getPayGradeById
methods.description: Retrieves a PayGrade entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingPayGradeIds
methods.description: Fetches existing pay grade IDs from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getPayGradeList
methods.description: Returns a list of PayGrade entities based on search filters.

methods.name: getPayGradesPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginated query for listing PayGrades with applied filters.

methods.name: getCurrencyListByPayGradeId
methods.description: Fetches a list of currencies associated with a specific pay grade.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginated query for PayGradeCurrency entities based on filters.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of PayGradeCurrency entities matching filter params.

methods.name: getPayGradeCurrencyListCount
methods.description: Counts the number of PayGradeCurrency entities based on filter params.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCurrencyIdAndPayGradeId
methods.description: Fetches a PayGradeCurrency entity by currency ID and pay grade ID.

methods.name: getPayPeriods
methods.description: Retrieves all PayPeriod entities.

methods.name: getCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves all CurrencyType entities.

methods.name: getCurrencyById
methods.description: Fetches a CurrencyType entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingCurrencyIdsForPayGradeId
methods.description: Fetches existing currency IDs associated with a specific pay grade.

methods.name: getPayGradesCount
methods.description: Counts total pay grades based on search filters.

methods.name: savePayGrade
methods.description: Persists a PayGrade entity to the database.

methods.name: savePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Persists a PayGradeCurrency entity.

methods.name: deletePayGrades
methods.description: Deletes multiple PayGrade entities by their IDs.

methods.name: deletePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Deletes PayGradeCurrency records associated with a pay grade.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves currencies allowed for a specific pay grade.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrenciesCount
methods.description: Counts allowed currencies for a specific pay grade.

methods.name: getAllowedPayCurrenciesPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for allowed pay currencies.
